2026-03-04T15:52:28.3758433Z ## Phase 6: History Pruning
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3758721Z 
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3758995Z Prune old daily summary comments on the dashboard issue.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3759442Z 
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3759595Z ### Steps:
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3760116Z 1. Use the **github tool** to list ALL comments on the dashboard issue.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3761175Z 2. Filter to comments whose body starts with `## 📋 Health Check`. Never hide human comments.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3762148Z 3. Parse the date from each: `## 📋 Health Check — {date}`.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3762768Z 4. Apply retention:
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3763218Z    - Age ≤ 10 days → KEEP
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3763951Z    - 10 days < age ≤ 1 year → keep only the latest per ISO week, mark others for hiding
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3764741Z    - Age > 1 year → mark for hiding
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3765684Z 5. Use `hide-comment` safe output with reason `OUTDATED` for each marked comment.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3766506Z 6. Max 60 hides per run. Prioritize oldest if > 60.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3767171Z 7. Skip already-hidden comments and unparseable dates.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3767784Z 8. First run: skip pruning entirely.
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3768127Z 
2026-03-04T15:52:28.3768277Z ---
